mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_keys (user_id, key_hash, name) SELECT id, #{keyHash}, #{name} FROM users WHERE username = #{username}
mapper.select: SELECT ak.id, ak.user_id, u.username, ak.key_hash, ak.name, ak.created_at, ak.last_used_at, ak.revoked_at FROM api_keys ak JOIN users u ON u.id = ak.user_id WHERE ak.key_hash = #{keyHash} AND ak.revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE api_keys SET last_used_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE api_keys ak JOIN users u ON u.id = ak.user_id SET ak.revoked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ak.id = #{id} AND u.username = #{username} AND ak.revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT ak.id, ak.user_id, u.username, ak.key_hash, ak.name, ak.created_at, ak.last_used_at, ak.revoked_at FROM api_keys ak JOIN users u ON u.id = ak.user_id WHERE u.username = #{username} ORDER BY ak.created_at DESC
